section_11_failure_bar_assessment.bar: Using measured q8 results as the internal reference (Section 11 of the Phase 10A brief): flag q4 as problematic if logit rel-L2 increases by an order of magnitude vs q8, delta NLL becomes materially worse, or top1 preservation drops dramatically relative to q8.
section_11_failure_bar_assessment.verdict: FLAGGED. On both tested models, q4's logit rel-L2 and delta NLL are more than an order of magnitude worse than q8's (12.8x-13.4x and 49.6x-58.6x respectively), and top1 preservation drops materially (88.7%-92.6% vs 98.8% for q8). q4 also diverges from the native reference earlier than q8 in both runs (step 28-32 vs 40-87). This is a real, reproducible quality cost, not memory-savings-obscured noise.
